WEBSITE INFORMATION

Your information.

This notice describes the behavior implemented in this rebuilt website. It is not a replacement for the business’s full privacy policy.

Request preparation

The contact-page checklist is processed in your browser and is not sent to a server or stored by this website. Copying a summary uses your device clipboard only when requested.

Session preference

The homepage entrance stores a session flag in your browser to avoid repeated playback. If browser storage is unavailable, the site remains usable.

Optional maps and external booking

Google Maps loads only when requested or when a location control is used. Google receives normal connection data when its map loads. The booking link opens plumbingicu.com, whose data handling applies to submitted requests. No analytics have been added to this rebuild.

Owner review required

No existing business privacy policy was found in the original site’s accessible links. The business owner should supply and review its applicable policy before moving this build to the business domain.
